hero.tagline: Golang · Node.js · TypeScript · PostgreSQL · Redis · Docker
hero.bio:
Backend developer with experience building and maintaining APIs and backend services.

Specialized in end-to-end solution development, from requirements analysis to deployment and production support. I focus on building reliable and scalable systems using Node.js/TypeScript and Go.

Experienced in third-party integrations, database modeling, access control, and performance optimization in critical environments.

item1.description: Developed and maintained web solutions in an international environment, improving the clinic's digital presence.
achievements: Optimized web components to enhance user experience.
Collaborated in a multicultural team following international standards.

item2.description: Designed and implemented the API core and content management system.
achievements: Designed and developed REST APIs in Node.js/Express.
Implemented JWT authentication and granular access control.
Integrated Cloudinary for media management and CDN delivery.
Set up CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions for automated deployments.

item3.description: Supported the maintenance of web platforms and integration of marketing tools.
achievements: Proactive maintenance of existing web functionalities.
Integration of APIs and webhooks for internal workflow automation.

item4.description: Specialized in critical integrations and backend performance optimization.
achievements: Robust synchronization with third-party APIs (WooCommerce) handling large data volumes.
Implementation of idempotency, retry mechanisms, and backpressure control.
Performance incident resolution and tuning of complex SQL queries.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of projects showcasing my technical skills and problem-solving approach.

item1.title: GoPotency - Idempotency in Go
item1.description: Go library/middleware designed to easily apply idempotency to HTTP endpoints. Ensures critical operations are not duplicated, supporting body-hash and header-based key strategies with persistent storage in Postgres or Redis.

item2.title: QuickAttendance - Go Migration
item2.description: Migrated and evolved the core attendance system to Go using Clean Architecture. Implements multi-tenant architecture, async task processing with RabbitMQ, and real-time monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana.

item3.title: AutoAttendance - Microservices
item3.description: Comprehensive attendance management system based on microservices. Includes QR check-in, geofencing for remote attendance, and a secure authentication system. Capstone project with a robust Node.js backend and relational database.

topgg.title: Bot Status Notice
paragraphs: Mankekito is currently undergoing a major update. While the original code is deprecated and the bot is temporarily offline, you can still view its profile on Top.gg, a professional Discord bot listing platform.

The bot achieved official verification status and served over 10,000 users across more than 260 servers during its active period. A new version with improved features and modern architecture is in development.
